scenarios.name: 2008 GFC
scenarios.description: Global Financial Crisis, Sep-Nov 2008. Equities and high-yield crater, banks worst hit, oil collapses; Treasuries and gold rally on flight-to-quality.

scenarios.name: 2020 COVID Crash
scenarios.description: COVID-19 selloff, Feb 19 - Mar 23 2020. Sharp broad equity drawdown, energy collapses, high-yield gaps wider; Treasuries up, gold sold early for liquidity.

scenarios.name: 1987 Black Monday
scenarios.description: Oct 19 1987 single-day crash. S&P 500 fell ~20.5% in one session; broad equity shock, modest bond rally.

scenarios.name: Equity -20%
scenarios.description: Broad equity index down 20%. Applied via the equity factor beta of each asset.

scenarios.name: Credit Spreads +200bps
scenarios.description: Credit spreads widen 200bps (0.02). Applied via each asset's credit_spread beta; hits LQD and especially HYG.

scenarios.name: USD +10%
scenarios.description: Trade-weighted USD strengthens 10%. Applied via each asset's usd beta (gold, intl equity and oil fall; Treasuries little changed).
